m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Recall, fair citizens, stories of our ancestors. Grandmother Raven herself crafted our world and each of its peoples to bind the Chaos Heart.
Together we are the body Empyrea. The industrious Dwarves our hands, the wise Alphoi our brain, the Kalamar the blood in our veins...
...And we are Empyrea's muscle, defenders of Order, the army of Raven. We are the light that pierces the dark and light cannot be destroyed!
Thus we present the Bat, son of Grandfather Spider, whose Heart we've guarded for generations. This is our final triumph. Off with his head!
Wait, my dear Vicereine. Are we not more civilized than he? Let the fiend stand trial for his crimes. Give the peoples of Empyrea closure.
Yes, Lord Vanitus, you are right as always. Guards, take this demon to the dungeons. We will deal with him in our own time.
Wow, not so much as a name drop. Well, he may not give us credit, but Vanitus still owes us the location of the Luminiferous Essence.
That balcony appears to connect to the Central Spire. I believe I saw a public entrance in the Citadel Proper. Let us go.
Well, ain't you an odd one. Human, huh? Never heard of it. Me, I'm an Aero Dwarf, from the Aero Plains. I came here on an Aeroship.
Yeah, we're a thematically consistent bunch, that's for sure. But you can just call me Josiah. No Aero there.
You on your way to the Citadel? Ha! I been waiting out here forever, trying to get an audience.
High-falutin' Vicereine won't give me the time of day. Makes me so mad sometimes, I... I don't know what I'll do. I hope you have better luck.
And so the bugs scurry away from the Forces of Light! As they should. Flee, miscreants, flee for your lives!
Wait! Where is Captain Pork?
I... I can't be sure with all the commotion. But I do believe I saw those Dark Cloud brigands carry him away.
Then we must rescue him at once.
Yes, of course you must. Lord Vanitus, see to the details of the rescue outside, would you? We feel we must rest.
As you wish, Vicereine. Come, Wizard, meet me in the Citadel Proper.
Now, Wizard, let us attend to the rescue of your friend.
Did you enjoy your homecoming, Mr. Sparck?
Not remotely, Captain.
Glad to hear it. Vanitus' party is about to start. It's just in this Courtyard right here. Let's go.
Hurry, Wizard. I don't want to miss a second of this. Let's get to the Royal Courtyard.
